implementationPoints: Extend the owned ReplayTerminal with explicitly armed read/write gates and first-failure injection; no production API/controller/session/transport edits.
Extend owned ReplayHarness.Start/Close to preserve the original run/paint/read/write tasks and expected-failure receipts rather than hide faults behind the current EOF-only close.
Use existing TerminalChatInput host routes and actual TerminalSessionView. Do not seed Source text/cursor, claim a partial frame equality, acquire real console handles or dispose borrowed terminals.
executionPrerequisite: Fresh parent policy-permitted boundary; no native build/run, blocked artifact retry/repackaging/alternate host, or full/physical gate substitution authorized.
